title: ID0431038-DC/Si-D/GB-[MP / R0 170002822] Charger is unreliable
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Customer reports that charger is unreliable - right outlet has been
reported to work rarely, and left outlet sometimes stops charging
before the session is complete. Only obvious thing in the logs is the
below message, repeated frequently. Advice needed
Solution: Restart sicharge-cp-backend container

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431038/DC/Si-D/GB-[MP / R0 170002822]charger is unreliable CRM:02681000322
additional_info.body:
Hi Beerpal,
I am scheduling a meeting with the customer to discuss – what they report is the following:
The right outlet will ONLY work if we also start a charge on the left outlet.
For me, I don’t believe that – I think they are using a bus with 2x CCS charge ports, and I also believe there is a problem with the bus which is inhibiting one of the ports. I can’t think of a charge fault which would cause this behaviour.
Please keep the ticket open and I will add details to it.
Thanks,
Jason
